rows.value: UW Ocean Data Lab DAS Subsea Cable and PAM Hydrophone Array

rows.label: What the project is
rows.value: The University of Washington (UW) Ocean Data Lab proposes to deploy and operate two new temporary scientific measurement devices: a Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) subsea fiber optic cable and a moored vertical array with multiple hydrophones for Passive Acoustic Monitoring (PAM), waterward of the mean high-water mark of Haro Strait.
